source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the preparation of esters (PDF 113).

items: Carboxylic acids aur alcohols se (Fischer esterification), tezaab mein: CH3CH2COOH + CH3CH2OH <=> CH3CH2COOCH2CH3 + H2O (H+), ethyl propanoate. Aam taur par RCOOH + HOR' <=> RCOOR' + H2O: tezaab ka C-OH bond aur alcohol ka O-H bond toot'ta hai.

Acyl chlorides aur alcohols se: acyl chlorides alcohols se tezi se react karte hain; reaction mukammal hota aur equilibrium mixture nahi banata: CH3COCl + CH3CH2OH -> CH3COOCH2CH3 + HCl (ethyl ethanoate).
Acyl chlorides aur phenol se: acyl chloride ko phenol ke saath garam karne par phenyl esters bante hain (Chapter 22), maslan C6H5COCl + C6H5OH -> C6H5COOC6H5 + HCl (phenyl benzoate).

blocks.alt: Propanoic acid, CH3-CH2-C(=O)-OH, + ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH, equilibrium teeron par H+, se ethyl propanoate, CH3-CH2-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3, + H2O.
blocks.caption: Propanoic acid aur ethanol se ethyl propanoate (kitab ke PDF safha 113 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: R-C(=O)-OH + H-O-R, equilibrium teeron par H+, se R-C(=O)-OR + H2O. Do teer 'Bond Cleavage': tezaab ka C-OH bond aur alcohol ka H-O bond.
blocks.caption: Aam esterification, tootne wale bonds ke saath (kitab ke PDF safha 113 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 'Bond Cleavage' ke teer batate hain ke tezaab ka C-OH bond aur alcohol ka O-H bond toot'ta hai: tezaab ka OH aur alcohol ka H mil kar paani bante hain, aur alcohol ka O-R carbonyl carbon se jur kar ester banata hai.

blocks.alt: Ethanoyl chloride, CH3-C(=O)-Cl, + ethanol, CH3-CH2-O-H, se ethyl ethanoate, CH3-C(=O)-O-CH2-CH3, + HCl, aik-rukha teer.
blocks.caption: Ethanoyl chloride aur ethanol se ethyl ethanoate (kitab ke PDF safha 113 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Ester banane ke liye carboxylic acid ki jagah aksar acyl chloride kyun use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh kamre ke darja hararat par jaldi react karta aur reaction mukammal hota hai (HCl nikal jata hai), jab ke tezaab aur alcohol equilibrium mixture dete hain.

items: Tezaab + alcohol <=> ester + paani (H+): tezaab ka C-OH aur alcohol ka O-H toot'ta.
Acyl chloride + alcohol ya phenol -> ester + HCl, mukammal.
